diagnostics.note: diagnostics are not expectations. C4 keeps `mucin` as its own branch: the picker returns four kinds and folding one into another would be D-168's section 3 defect

keys.C2: representatives whose accession HAS a protein_features row, but attached to a different analysis_id than the representative's (a stale representative). Count AND ids; no pre-set expectation -- the count is the measurement
keys.C3: cohort rows (cohort_tranche = 0) with no protein_features row -- this decides P2
keys.C4: C1a broken down by the structure_kind the picker returned: assembled / tiles_only / single-pass / mucin, each branch its own count, never a subtraction from a total
